title: turn (referee to bot)
description: Starts the bot's thinking time. The bot answers with move or resign.

last_move.description: The opponent's last move, or null if the bot makes the first move of the game.

fen.description: Position after last_move. The SDK compares it with its own board; on a mismatch it logs a warning and adopts this position (repetition history is lost).

ply.description: Number of half-moves played since start_fen.

remaining_ms.description: Own remaining time when the referee sent this message.
